title: Towards Reliable Truth-Aligned Uncertainty Estimation in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.00445v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Uncertainty estimation (UE) aims to quantify uncertainty in large language model (LLM) outputs to flag potential hallucinations and support reliable deployment. However, UE metrics often exhibit unstable performance across models and datasets, limiting their practical utility. We formalise this phenomenon as proxy failure, arising because UE metrics are derived from model behaviour rather than being explicitly grounded in factual correctness. We show that when mutual information between a UE score and correctness is low, the score's discriminability must be close to chance. To address this, we propose Truth AnChoring (TAC), a lightweight post-hoc calibration method that maps raw UE scores to truth-aligned correctness probabilities. Even with noisy and few-shot supervision, TAC continues to improve calibration, providing a practical calibration protocol. Our findings highlight the limitations of treating heuristic UE metrics as direct

translated_title: 迈向大语言模型中可靠的真实对齐不确定性估计
translated_abstract: 不确定性估计（UE）旨在量化大语言模型（LLM）输出中的不确定性，以标记潜在的幻觉并支持可靠部署。然而，UE指标在不同模型和数据集上往往表现出不稳定的性能，限制了其实际效用。我们将这一现象形式化为“代理失效”（proxy failure），其产生的原因是UE指标源自模型行为，而非明确地基于事实正确性。我们证明，当UE分数与正确性之间的互信息较低时，该分数的判别能力必然接近随机水平。为解决这一问题，我们提出了真实锚定（Truth AnChoring, TAC），这是一种轻量级的后验校准方法，可将原始UE分数映射为与真实对齐的正确性概率。即使在有噪声的少样本监督条件下，TAC仍能持续改善校准效果，提供了一种实用的校准协议。我们的发现强调了将启发式UE指标直接视为（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出真实锚定方法，一种轻量级后验校准技术，通过将大语言模型的原始不确定性估计分数映射为真实对齐的正确性概率，解决了UE指标在不同模型和数据集上性能不稳定的“代理失效”问题，即使在有噪声的少样本监督下也能持续提升校准效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes Truth AnChoring (TAC), a lightweight post-hoc calibration method that maps raw uncertainty estimation scores to truth-aligned correctness probabilities, addressing the proxy failure problem where UE metrics perform unstably across models and datasets, and improving calibration even with noisy few-shot supervision.
